name: context-intake
description: Recover context, clarify user requirements and scenarios, and produce an evidence-linked handoff before specialized domain work.

interface.longDescription: Understand a prompt, recover accepted decisions, discover actors and end-to-end scenarios, resolve consequential gaps, and safely hand off to Software, UI/UX, automation or another domain. Uses existing host tools and a versioned local handoff contract.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $context-intake:context-intake to understand my request, recover available context, clarify material requirements and prepare the pre-domain handoff.
